title: Concept: Debug mode enabled in python — review required
description: In python, debug mode is enabled through a literal setting. When that configuration reaches production the framework serves stack traces, environment details, and interactive debugger endpoints to whoever triggers an error. Those pages have repeatedly turned a benign exception into credential disclosure or code execution.
applicability: python web frameworks and development servers; lexical scope.
risk: Information disclosure and debugger-assisted code execution; MEDIUM severity.
